subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the stale assertions are repaired, do workflow and security owners approve executing this grouped set of privileged third-party action revisions on the final exact head?
rationale: Automated checks can verify syntax and assertion consistency, but they cannot accept the trust-boundary change for actions receiving credentials, write access, publishing access, or security artifacts.

options.title: Repair and approve grouped update
options.body: Synchronize the assertions, rerun exact-head checks, and approve the grouped revisions after owner source review.

options.title: Split privileged revisions
options.body: Separate the app-token, Codex, CodeQL, and container-publishing upgrades for independent security review.

options.title: Pause the dependency batch
options.body: Keep the PR open until the privileged revisions and Dependabot update path are stable enough for final review.

recommendation.title: Repair and approve grouped update
recommendation.body: Synchronize the assertions, rerun exact-head checks, and approve the grouped revisions after owner source review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent guard provenance and direct PR engagement make this the strongest individual routing candidate, alongside the secops owner group.
